Short title and commencement

PROVINCIAL LAW OFFICERS ORDINANCE, 2001
PROVINCIAL LAW OFFICERS ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance
to provide for the appointment of Provincial Law Officers
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
9th
September, 20011
No. Legis.1‑133/Law/2001,
dated 22‑8‑2001.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 20th August, 2001 is
hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Provincial
Law Officers Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Definitions

August, 2001 is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Definitions.‑‑In
this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context:
(a) "Provincial Law Officer" merits the Additional
Advocate General and Assistant Advocate‑General,
(b) "Court" means Supreme Court of Pakistan, High Courts.
Federal Shariat Court. Service Tribunals and Election Tribunals;'
(c) "Governor" means the Governor of Balochistan;
(d) "Government" means the Government of Balochistan;
(e) "Rules" means the rules made under this Ordinance;
(f) "Department" means the law Department.

Appointment of Provincial Law Officer

3. Appointment or
Provincial Law Officer.‑‑(1) The Governor may appoint one or
more Additional Advocate‑General and Assistant Advocate General as he may
consider necessary.
(2) A persons appointed under subsection (1) shall hold office
during the pleasure of the Governor and shall receive Such remuneration and
shall be subject to such conditions as may be determined by the Rules made
under

4. Qualification
of Provincial Law Officers.‑‑No person shall be appointed
under subsection (1 ) of section 3, unless:‑‑
(a) in case of an Additional Advocate‑General he is qualified
for appointment its Judge of the High Court, or. he has minimum standing of 3
year, as Assistant Advocate‑General;
(b) in case of Assistant Advocate‑General
lie has 7 years' practice of High Court.

Audience.‑‑‑In the performance of their official duties
the Additional Advocate‑General and Assistant Advocate‑General
shall have the right of audience in all Courts in Pakistan.
